item.title: Pay-Walled Live Stream Integration

Here’s what I need you to handle:

item.title: AWS Website Migration & SEO Preservation
item.description:
250-750 USD | Website Migration, Domain Restructuring & AWS Infrastructure Setup – sanaco.com.sa to sana.com.sa
Project Overview We are looking for an experienced Website Migration Specialist / AWS Cloud Architect to manage a website migration and infrastructure restructuring project.
Our existing website, sanaco.com.sa, is currently hosted on Amazon AWS Lightsail. The website has a database exceeding 150 GB and contains substantial business content, products, categories and SEO-optimised pages.
Management has decided to use sana.com.sa for the existing website content and business activities, while retaining sanaco.com.sa for a different business purpose with separate content and functionality.
We need an experienced professional to plan and execute this migration without losing existing website data, SEO value, organic search visibility or business functionality.
Project Objectives Migrate the existing website from sanaco.com.sa to sana.com.sa. Preserve all existing products, categories, website content, images and relevant database records. Protect the SEO investment made on 268 optimised product pages. Implement appropriate 301 redirects from the old domain to the new domain. Retain sanaco.com.sa and prepare it for a completely different website and business purpose. Establish an efficient, secure and scalable AWS hosting architecture. Minimise website downtime and avoid data loss during migration. Scope of Work 1. Existing Website and Infrastructure Audit Analyse the existing website architecture. Review the AWS Lightsail hosting environment. Identify the website technology, programming language and database engine. Audit the existing database (150+ GB). Analyse website files, media storage, plugins and integrations. Identify unnecessary database records and technical issues. Evaluate the existing server's performance and resource utilisation. 2. Website Migration to sana.com.sa Create the new production environment for sana.com.sa. Migrate the existing website application and required files. Migrate the database and associated media. Preserve products, categories, attributes, variations and relevant business records. Preserve customer and historical transaction data where required. Configure domain DNS, SSL and server settings. Test all website functionalities before launch. 3. SEO Preservation and Migration SEO preservation is a critical requirement of this project.
We have already completed SEO optimisation for 268 products on sanaco.com.sa.
The selected freelancer must ensure:
Preservation of existing product URLs wherever possible. Migration of all SEO titles and meta descriptions. Preservation of product descriptions and headings. Preservation of image ALT tags and relevant image assets. Preservation of structured data and schema markup. Correct canonical tag configuration. Updated internal linking structure. Updated XML sitemap. Updated robots.txt configuration. Individual 301 redirects from old URLs to corresponding new URLs. No unnecessary redirect chains or redirect loops. Verification of Google Search Console and indexing configuration. All 268 SEO-optimised products must be checked after migration.
Important: Redirecting all old URLs to the new homepage will not be accepted. Redirects must point to relevant equivalent pages.
4. Repurposing sanaco.com.sa After migrating the existing website to sana.com.sa:
sanaco.com.sa must remain operational. The domain will be used for a different business purpose. The new website must have an independent application and content structure. The new website must have a separate database. Historical URLs from the old website must continue to redirect appropriately to their corresponding pages on sana.com.sa. The new website must not interfere with the existing SEO migration strategy. 5. AWS Infrastructure and Database Optimisation We are open to recommendations regarding the best AWS architecture.
Potential technologies include:
AWS Lightsail Amazon EC2 Amazon RDS Amazon S3 Amazon CloudFront AWS Route 53 AWS Backup Amazon CloudWatch The freelancer should recommend whether to:
Retain and optimise the existing Lightsail infrastructure. Move to EC2 and RDS. Implement another cost-effective AWS architecture. The two websites should have independent applications and databases, even if they share appropriate AWS infrastructure.
The proposed solution must consider security, scalability, performance, backup and disaster recovery.
6. Testing and Quality Assurance Before final deployment, the freelancer must verify:
All 268 SEO product pages. Product images and media files. Product categories and variations. Website navigation and internal links. Forms and integrations. Customer accounts and historical records where applicable. Database integrity. SSL certificates. Website loading speed. Mobile responsiveness. HTTP status codes and redirects. Google indexing and sitemap configuration. 7. Post-Migration Support The freelancer should provide post-launch technical support to resolve migration-related issues.
We also require documentation of:
New AWS architecture. Database migration procedure. Website deployment process. Backup and recovery procedures. DNS and domain configuration. Redirect mapping. Technical handover documentation. Expected Deliverables Technical audit report of the existing website. Recommended AWS infrastructure architecture. Fully migrated website on sana.com.sa. Independent website infrastructure for sanaco.com.sa. Migrated database and website files. SEO migration and URL redirect mapping. Verification report for all 268 SEO-optimised products. Performance and security testing report. AWS configuration and technical documentation. Post-migration support. Required Freelancer Skills We are looking for a professional with proven experience in:
AWS Lightsail. Amazon EC2 and RDS. MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL, as applicable. Large database migrations (100 GB+). Website domain migrations. SEO migration and 301 redirects. Google Search Console. Website performance optimisation. Cloud infrastructure and server administration. Database backup and disaster recovery. Experience with complex production website migrations is highly preferred.
Important Project Requirements Experience with large databases is mandatory. SEO migration experience is essential. The freelancer must provide a clear migration strategy before implementation. Full backups must be taken before any production changes. The migration must be tested in a staging environment. No existing website data should be deleted without approval. Website downtime should be kept to a minimum. All website and infrastructure credentials must be handled securely. All project work and documentation must be handed over upon completion. What to Include in Your Proposal Please provide the following information when submitting your bid:
Describe your experience migrating websites with databases exceeding 100 GB. Have you previously migrated websites between two domains while preserving SEO rankings? What AWS architecture would you recommend for this project? How would you handle the migration of the 150+ GB database? How would you preserve the SEO value of 268 optimised product pages? What is your estimated project timeline? What is your estimated total project cost? What post-migration support do you provide? We prefer freelancers who can demonstrate previous successful projects involving AWS infrastructure, large database migration and SEO-preserving domain migration.

item.description:

Project Overview We are seeking a skilled and experienced full-stack developer to build a secure, mobile-friendly web application for real-time security and yard management. The application will be the central hub for our operations, used by security guards, customers, and the site owner to efficiently track trucks, trailers, and on-site activities.
The primary goal is to replace our manual processes with a streamlined digital solution for logging truck entry/exit, reporting damages, managing customer schedules, and providing a live, comprehensive dashboard for the owner.
Key Features & Deliverables The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and delivering a fully functional, tested, and documented web application with the following core features:
Guard Portal (Mobile-First UI):
Reporting: A quick-entry form to log truck/trailer numbers, full/empty status, and entry/exit timestamps.
Damage Reports: Ability to submit detailed reports with photo uploads.
Event Log: A section for adding custom notes and event details.
Customer Portal:
Emergency Contacts: Each customer's page must display their emergency contact information.
Visitor Management: Customers can add and delete approved visitors (trucks/drivers) directly.
Real-time Tracking: A live view showing all of the customer's trucks and trailers currently inside and outside the yard, along with their loaded status (full/empty).
Pre-Scheduling: A simple interface for customers to pre-submit scheduled truck/trailer arrivals.
Approval Queue: Customers will have an interface to approve or deny visitor access requests made via QR code.
Owner/Master Portal:
User Management: Functionality to assign guards to specific sites and manage user roles.
Reporting & Analytics: Advanced filtering and export capabilities for all reports.
Real-time Dashboard: A live dashboard showing all vehicles currently in the yard, updated instantly via WebSockets or similar technology.
The QR Code & Access Approval Workflow This is a critical part of the project. The system must support the following multi-step approval process:
A first-time visitor (e.g., a truck driver) will scan a QR code at the property entrance.
The QR code directs them to a secure web form where they can request access.
This request then enters an approval queue that is visible to the relevant customer and the site's security guard.
Both the customer and the guard must be able to manually review and approve or deny the request. Access is not granted automatically.
Upon approval, the guard's portal is updated, allowing them to proceed with the truck's check-in.
Technical Stack & Requirements We are looking for a developer with hands-on experience in building scalable solutions. Our preferred tech stack for this project is:
Frontend: React (with a mobile-first, responsive design).
Backend: Node.js (Express) or Laravel (PHP).
Database: MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Hosting: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP is required.
Security: Robust, role-based access control and secure authentication (e.g., JWT).
Real-time: Proficient with WebSockets or similar technology for live updates (for both the owner and customer portals).
Additional Skills: Experience with file/photo uploads and multi-stage approval workflows.
Ideal Candidate & How to Apply We are seeking a freelancer or small team with a proven track record of developing complex, secure applications that incorporate reporting and real-time features.
Please include the following in your application:
A brief overview of your relevant experience.
Links to past projects or live demos, especially those involving dashboards or reporting.

Your estimated timeline for completion and a proposed budget.
We are ready to start this project immediately with the right partner.
Thank you for your interest!
